recognize_zh: 抹片上一顆大型細胞的豐富細胞質呈細顆粒狀的紅紫色陽性反應，周圍紅血球為未染色的黃色，符合高雪氏細胞的細胞化學染色（可能為抗酒石酸酸性磷酸酶 TRAP）陽性；核本身不易辨識。
features: Large cell with abundant cytoplasm showing diffuse, finely granular red-purple positive staining
Staining is densest centrally and fades toward the cell periphery
Nucleus is obscured and not clearly discernible
Surrounding red cells appear yellow and unstained, with no counterstained background cells
Image resolution and staining limit identification of the specific cytochemical reaction
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with a cytochemical reaction shows a large cell with abundant cytoplasm displaying diffuse, finely granular red-purple positivity, most intense centrally. The nucleus is obscured by the reaction product. Adjacent red cells are yellow and unstained. The appearance is most suggestive of an acid phosphatase (tartrate-resistant) reaction, although the stain is not labeled and a PAS reaction cannot be excluded. Findings are consistent with a cytochemically positive Gaucher cell.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts are also strongly TRAP positive but show multiple discrete nuclei, whereas Gaucher cells have one or few small eccentric nuclei.
Hairy cells are TRAP positive but are much smaller lymphoid cells with circumferential hairy projections.
Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML or myeloma can share cytochemical reactivity, so enzyme assay or GBA testing and marrow context are required.
